name: Organization and Team Hierarchy
description: Organizations contain teams. Teams contain members. The hierarchy controls visibility, authority delegation, and capability scoping across organizational boundaries.
purpose: Model real-world organizational structures within a cell so that authority and visibility follow the org chart.
acceptanceCriteria: Organization entity defined with name, slug, owner, member list, settings
Team entity defined with name, parent organization, member list, settings
Nested hierarchy: organizations contain teams, teams contain members
Hierarchy controls visibility scope — org-wide vs team-scoped resources
Authority delegation: org owner can delegate authority to team leads
Organization and team creation receipted and auditable
